Fakultaet, Universitaet Bern. xxvii+905 pp. DOI 10.48620/94570, URN urn:nbn:ch:bel-bes-12243 (CC BY 4.0). fetched sources from the Swiss National Library e-Helvetica deposit (bel-bes-12243/data/).
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: not located online or at Harvard
sources.note: Silent. Sec. 2.1 Phonologie (pp. 91-133) of the West Mewahang sketch treats consonant inventory, vowel inventory (6 vowels with phonemic length; p.102 short vowels in open syllables freely realised half-long to long), syllable structure/phonotactics (pp.105-106) and morphophonology; there is no section or sentence on word accent, stress or tone (full-text grep of Akzent/Betonung/betont/Ton/prosod/stress). The only accent remarks are in Appendix C about Hodgson's 1857 diacritics, p.758: 'Die Bedeutung des Akzents, der von Hodgson reichlich verwendet wird, erschliesst sich nicht'.

sources.citation: Banjade, Goma. 2009. Mewahang language: an introduction. Nepalese Linguistics 24: 11-20 (Glottolog files it under Uranw & Yadav 2009; byline is Goma Banjade). Describes the eastern (Yaphu) dialect per Gerber 2023: 22.
sources.note: Silent: sec. 2 Phonology lists 7 vowels (with length contrast) and 27 consonants with minimal pairs; nothing on stress or tone.

sources.citation: Ebert, Karen H. 2003. Kiranti languages: an overview. In Thurgood & LaPolla (eds.), The Sino-Tibetan Languages, ch. 31 (on-disk djvu text in ling tree).
sources.note: No stress statement for Kiranti generally or Mewahang (Mewahang only appears in the classification tree; tone mentioned for Khaling/Thulung).

sources.citation: Grierson, G. A. (ed.; Tibeto-Burman part by Sten Konow). 1909. Linguistic Survey of India III.1, Tibeto-Burman family: 'Minor Khambu dialects' pp. 341-342 and 'Balali' pp. 350-351 (based on Hodgson 1857).
sources.note: Silent on stress: 'The materials are not sufficient for describing the phonetic system of the various dialects. The so-called abrupt tone occurs in all of them... Balali pih' cow' (glottal stop), plus Hodgson's 'pausing tone'.
